HolonomyDescentObstructionCorrectedProbe.transport-roundtrip:
{ℓ : Level} {A B : Type ℓ} (r : A ≡ B) (a : A) →
transport (sym r) (transport r a) ≡ a
HolonomyDescentObstructionCorrectedProbe.transport-naturality:
{ℓ : Level} {ℓ' = A : Level} {ℓ'' = B : Level} {X = r : Type ℓ}
{O = a : Type A} (q : r → a) (F : r → Type B) (D : a → Type B)
(comparison : (x : r) → F x ≡ D (q x)) {x y : r} (p : x ≡ y)
(a₁ : F x) →
transport (comparison y) (transport (cong F p) a₁) ≡
transport (cong D (cong q p)) (transport (comparison x) a₁)
HolonomyDescentObstructionCorrectedProbe.descent-kills-kernel-holonomy:
{ℓ : Level} {ℓ' = A : Level} {ℓ'' = B : Level} {X = r : Type ℓ}
{O = a : Type A} (q : r → a) (F : r → Type B) (D : r) (x : D ≡ D)
(comparison : F D) →
cong q x ≡ refl →
DependentFactorsThrough q F →
transport (cong F x) comparison ≡ comparison
HolonomyDescentObstructionCorrectedProbe.kernel-holonomy-obstructs-descent:
{ℓ : Level} {ℓ' = A : Level} {ℓ'' = B : Level} {X = r : Type ℓ}
{O = a : Type A} (q : r → a) (F : r → Type B) (D : r) (x : D ≡ D)
(comparison : F D) →
cong q x ≡ refl →
¬ transport (cong F x) comparison ≡ comparison →
¬ DependentFactorsThrough q F
HolonomyDescentObstructionCorrectedProbe.HolonomyWitness:
{ℓ : Level} {ℓ'' = A : Level} {X = B : Type ℓ} →
(B → Type A) → (r : B) → r ≡ r → Type A
HolonomyDescentObstructionCorrectedProbe.kernel-holonomy-witness-obstructs-descen:
{ℓ : Level} {ℓ' = A : Level} {ℓ'' = B : Level} {X = r : Type ℓ}
{O = a : Type A} (q : r → a) (F : r → Type B) (D : r) (x : D ≡ D) →
cong q x ≡ refl →
HolonomyWitness F D x → ¬ DependentFactorsThrough q F
HolonomyDescentObstructionCorrectedProbe.terminal-observation-obstruction:
{ℓ : Level} {ℓ'' = A : Level} {X = B : Type ℓ} (r : B → Type A)
(a : B) (q : a ≡ a) →
HolonomyWitness r a q → ¬ DependentFactorsThrough (λ _ → tt) r
